project: DĀR AL TAWḤĪD – Ḥadīṯ, Šarḥ & Āṯār
sourceBook: Ibn Abī Šaybah, al-Muṣannaf, Kitāb al-Adab, vol. 6

verification.originalSources: All ten report numbers and quoted Arabic excerpts checked against the corresponding Islamweb chapter pages; each record stores the full exact source URL and reported isnad.
verification.hadithVersusAthar: All ten marked Athar, no unsubstantiated marfu or verified Sharh.
verification.authenticity: No individual isnad graded sahih/hasan without full chain/illal analysis; each has precise caveat.
verification.duplicateScreen: Targeted GitHub search for Arabic source fragments, German concepts and names; not a complete full-corpus semantic duplicate evaluation.
verification.interpretation: Historical attitudes and practices are not turned into general legal mandates; questionable attribution notes kept.
verification.sourceEdition: The visible Islamweb volume/page is quoted as digital pagination; print edition not independently verified.
verification.publicUi: Internal HAD IDs stay backend-only; no card labels, breadcrumbs, source/number/share text.
verification.distribution: Identical production count and canonical ordering across web, iOS, Android, tvOS. Test app uses reduced sample; TV screensaver keeps its shuffle algorithm.
